title: StatPrism
description: StatPrism is a free, open-source desktop application for analysing survey and questionnaire data and producing publication-ready, APA-formatted tables and figures without writing code. It is aimed at researchers and students in psychology and the social sciences, and covers data import and cleaning, scale construction, descriptive and inferential statistics (correlation, group comparisons, reliability, exploratory and confirmatory factor analysis, SEM, and more), and export to Word.
